name: comment-margin
title: Comment Margin
description: Comment cards laid beside the text they are about — level with their highlight, stacked without overlap, the active card aligned with its text — and a CommentPopover anchored to a highlight for narrow screens.

meta.whenToUse: Inline comment threads beside a document (TextEdit annotations + onAnnotationsLayout) on wide screens; the popover below the margin breakpoint.
meta.whenNotToUse: A plain comments section under a record (CommentList), or touch-sized screens (Sheet side="bottom").
